Lost Crate Incident Report

This report concerns a misplaced pet crate and the steps taken to resolve the matter with care and order. During the afternoon intake, a traveler arrived at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways to advise that a crate linked to the journey could not be located after transfer from the check-in area. The traveler had already completed the required handover and was visibly concerned, but remained cooperative while I reviewed the file, the baggage notes, and the service log. I confirmed that the animal was not in distress and that the missing item was a crate, not the pet itself, which helped narrow the response. <<FACT F118>> I then asked the handling team to recheck the arrival zone, the loading lane, and the storage point used for overflow items.

The review showed that the crate had been separated during routine movement between departments and placed with other unattended equipment for temporary safekeeping. Once the crate was identified, I confirmed the tag details against the manifest and informed the traveler of the result in plain language. I also reminded the team that crate transfers must be recorded at each handoff, even when the move appears routine, so that the record remains clear and the traveler can be guided without delay. The traveler was given practical instructions on how to continue the journey process, and I explained the channel for any claim or further service follow-up without adding unnecessary complexity.

After the crate was recovered, the area was inspected to ensure there were no other mixed items or loose labels. I noted the event in the shift log and shared a calm summary with the crew so that future handling can stay consistent and reassuring. The matter was resolved without harm to the pet, and the traveler left with the necessary support and clear next steps. Companion Animal Travel Desk
